public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline. The search found post-publication evidence of credit stress, but no verified event satisfying the stated collapse-and-causation rule. Rising yields do not establish widespread project failure or show that optimism caused greater losses. The forecast remains open; the absence of a collapse by the freeze is not a contradiction.
limitations: Collapse and the claimed amplification require evaluator interpretation.
Market stress can precede a collapse or occur without one.
No finite period of continued operation alone falsifies this undated forecast.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The AI data center situation will collapse, made worse by widespread ignorance or optimism.

statement.excerpt: Everybody is either egregiously ignorant or hopelessly optimistic in a way that will make this situation so much worse when it collapses.

from_speaker: will make this situation so much worse
our_interpretation: Read the factual core as a forecast of a broad breakdown in the AI data center buildout, aggravated by widespread overoptimistic or poorly informed investment decisions.
Treat everybody as rhetorical generalization rather than a separately testable assertion about every person's mental state.
Collapse requires widespread failures, defaults or cancellations with substantial losses, rather than isolated setbacks or a temporary market decline.
The statement predicts collapse; when is not an external antecedent that must occur before an otherwise separate forecast is scored.
criteria.support_condition: A broad wave of AI data center failures, defaults or cancellations causes substantial losses, and credible investigations show that optimistic assumptions or inadequate diligence materially amplified those losses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A conclusively completed outcome for the relevant buildout demonstrates that the predicted breakdown did not occur, or a qualifying breakdown occurs with persuasive evidence against the claimed amplifying mechanism. Continued operation over a finite observation period is insufficient.

evidence.excerpt: This week, CoreWeave bond prices fell sharply, causing yields on the debt to top 15%.
evidence.locator: The News, paragraph discussing CoreWeave bond prices
evidence.explanation: This reputable news report documents credit stress after the forecast. A secondary-market repricing establishes neither widespread defaults and project failures nor the asserted causal effect of optimism.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated evidence of broad project failures or defaults and realized losses, together with credible findings connecting the severity of those losses to optimistic underwriting or inadequate diligence.
